assets.foundation:files/mise.sh:
# Managed by chezmoi. Activate the engine-managed mise in shells that have
# an activate hook (bash, zsh); plain sh has no activate variant, so it
# stays a no-op there — version resolution rides the engine's managed
# config and each project's .tool-versions either way.
#
# The engine owns the mise footprint end to end: the pinned binary lives
# in the engine's opt root (.local/opt/mise/<version>/bin/mise) and the
# engine's apply keeps the ~/.local/bin/mise symlink aimed at the current
# pin. This fragment activates THE ENGINE'S BINARY by absolute path and
# never a bare `mise` from PATH: PATH resolution binds whatever mise ranks
# first (on a host with a distro mise under /usr/bin that is never the
# engine's), and a foreign mise version paired with the engine's managed
# data and config split-brains every project tool resolution (the
# 2026-10-20 omarchy failure). Resolution order: the engine launcher
# symlink — honored only in its contract shape (../opt/mise/<version>/
# bin/mise), so a stray or foreign link is refused — else the sole
# opt-root pin (found with find, so zsh never trips an unmatched glob);
# anything else — an ambiguous multi-pin tree, an absent tree, a foreign
# file at the launcher path — activates nothing, because the engine's
# data and config are never handed to a non-engine mise. Both variables
# are mise-namespaced, so nothing outside mise sees them.
mise_engine_bin=
if [ -L "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" ]; then
  mise_link=$(readlink "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" 2>/dev/null || true)
  case $mise_link in
    ../opt/mise/*/bin/mise)
      mise_version=${mise_link#../opt/mise/}
      mise_version=${mise_version%/bin/mise}
      mise_engine_bin=$HOME/.local/opt/mise/$mise_version/bin/mise
      ;;
  esac
fi
if [ ! -x "$mise_engine_bin" ]; then
  mise_engine_bin=$(
    find "$HOME/.local/opt/mise" -type f -path '*/bin/mise' -perm -u+x 2>/dev/null |
      head -n 2
  )
  case $mise_engine_bin in
    # exactly one pin: keep it; none, or several (a superseded pin's tree
    # still on disk): refuse rather than guess
    '' | *'
'*) mise_engine_bin= ;;
  esac
fi
if [ -n "$mise_engine_bin" ]; then
  MISE_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.local/state/workstation/mise"
  MISE_CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.config/mise"
  export MISE_DATA_DIR MISE_CONFIG_DIR
  if [ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    eval "$("$mise_engine_bin" activate zsh)"
  elif [ -n "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    eval "$("$mise_engine_bin" activate bash)"
  fi
fi
unset mise_engine_bin mise_link mise_version
assets.node:files/nvm.sh:
# Managed by chezmoi. Load nvm and activate the engine-pinned default Node
# version, so fresh and reconciled hosts always resolve `node` on PATH.
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.local/opt/nvm"
if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
fi

# nvm only defines its shell function on load: a freshly provisioned tree
# ships no default alias, so interactive shells would get `nvm` but never
# `node` (the provisioned-but-dead failure class). Activate the pinned
# default here: resolve the recorded default alias, fall back to the sole
# provisioned version (seeding that alias through nvm once), and export the
# PATH, NVM_BIN and NVM_INC state `nvm use` would set — without paying its
# fork cost in every shell. An activation earlier in the shell (an explicit
# `nvm use`) always wins.
if [ -z "${NVM_BIN:-}" ] && [ -d "$NVM_DIR/versions/node" ]; then
  nvm_default=
  if [ -r "$NVM_DIR/alias/default" ]; then
    IFS= read -r nvm_default <"$NVM_DIR/alias/default"
  fi
  if [ -n "$nvm_default" ]; then
    nvm_default="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$nvm_default"
    [ -x "$nvm_default/bin/node" ] || nvm_default=
  fi
  if [ -z "$nvm_default" ]; then
    for nvm_entry in "$NVM_DIR"/versions/node/*; do
      [ -x "$nvm_entry/bin/node" ] || continue
      if [ -n "$nvm_default" ]; then
        nvm_default=
        break
      fi
      nvm_default=$nvm_entry
    done
    if [ -n "$nvm_default" ] && [ ! -e "$NVM_DIR/alias/default" ]; then
      nvm alias default "${nvm_default##*/}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$nvm_default" ]; then
    PATH="$nvm_default/bin:$PATH"
    export PATH
    NVM_BIN="$nvm_default/bin"
    export NVM_BIN
    NVM_INC="$nvm_default/include/node"
    export NVM_INC
    hash -r
  fi
  unset nvm_default nvm_entry
fi
assets.prompt:files/.config/starship.toml:
# Managed by the workstation terminal/prompt capability. The config values
# are byte-faithful to the operator's omarchy reference (basecamp/omarchy
# config/starship.toml, ruling 2026-10-19): the lean cyan prompt — directory
# (repo root bold), git branch/status, one character glyph. Plain colors, no
# theme slots — this file is data, not a template. The git_status glyphs are
# Nerd Font glyphs (the fonts package ships one).
add_newline = true
command_timeout = 200
format = "[$directory$git_branch$git_status]($style)$character"

[character]
error_symbol = "[✗](bold cyan)"
success_symbol = "[❯](bold cyan)"

[directory]
truncation_length = 2
truncation_symbol = "…/"
repo_root_style = "bold cyan"
repo_root_format = "[$repo_root]($repo_root_style)[$path]($style)[$read_only]($read_only_style) "

[git_branch]
format = "[$branch]($style) "
style = "italic cyan"

[git_status]
format     = '[$all_status]($style)'
style      = "cyan"
ahead      = "⇡${count} "
diverged   = "⇕⇡${ahead_count}⇣${behind_count} "
behind     = "⇣${count} "
conflicted = " "
up_to_date = " "
untracked  = "? "
modified   = " "
stashed    = ""
staged     = ""
renamed    = ""
deleted    = ""
